regime_context: The TSX detector shows broad non-dominant participation with Big Banks leading (elgible, crowded, mixed durability). Absolute-trend gate is validated for risk control. Momentum ranks have no forward return edge; high unscheduled macro event share (0.7) demands humility. All views are conditional trend-following leans.
emerging_watch: Watch for Big Banks durability_bar falling below 0.6 and losing eligibility, which could signal a confirmed leadership transition toward uncrowded, eligible themes like Utilities & Renewables. Kill-criterion: Big Banks durability_bar recovers above 0.7 and retains eligibility.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate (eligibility true) is the only validated edge (drawdown/shakeout avoidance). Big Banks remain above that gate with a durability_bar of 0.74, suggesting the trend is intact enough to ride. Crowding is a size-down caution, not a fade signal. Conditional overweight while eligibility holds.
evidence: gate_helps: true (validated risk control in backtests)
theses.dissent: High crowding (z=1.59) and mixed hurst could exhaust leadership. Macro narrative (AI/tech) may rotate capital away from bank-heavy TSX; negative rate surprise or credit event would reverse the trend.

falsifier.text: Big Banks loses absolute-trend eligibility (eligible becomes false in detector) OR ZEB.TO closes below its 10-day simple moving average and breadth narrows below 0.7 within 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The theme is mean-reverting (hurst_tag), with low durability (0.53) and no crowding to support momentum. While it remains eligible, the risk of a pullback is elevated. Avoid until a firmer trend structure emerges.
theses.dissent: Oil could rally on a geopolitical supply shock (macro narrative cites geopolitics) or a sharp demand surprise, overriding the mean-reverting tendency and lifting durability rapidly.

falsifier.text: Oil & Gas Producers durability_bar rises above 0.7 and hurst_tag shifts to 'trend' or 'mixed' within 20 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
